About.title: ABOUT US
About.subtitle: SOLID TESTING, BUILDING TRUST.
About.intro1: In the context of rapidly developing transportation infrastructure, construction quality is not just a requirement – it is a critical factor for success. Understanding this, HOANG ANH TRADING AND CONSTRUCTION JOINT STOCK COMPANY was established with the mission of becoming a leading provider in the field of on-site testing for transportation projects, delivering accurate, fast, and reliable inspection solutions.
About.intro2: With a team of highly experienced engineers, professionally trained and supported by modern equipment and machinery, we provide a full range of on-site testing services, including:
About.service4: Pile testing (PDA, PIT, static load testing, etc.)
About.service5: Monitoring and quality inspection of construction works
About.philosophy: We do not simply conduct tests – we deliver confidence in quality. Every result we provide ensures high accuracy, strictly complies with current technical standards, and helps investors and contractors control risks, optimize costs, and ensure project timelines.
About.diffTitle: What sets HOANG ANH TRADING AND CONSTRUCTION JOINT STOCK COMPANY apart:
About.diff1: Fast deployment, adaptable to all types of projects
About.conclusion: Through numerous projects nationwide, we are proud to be a trusted partner of many investors, contractors, and reputable consulting firms in the transportation sector.
About.slogan: HOANG ANH TRADING AND CONSTRUCTION JOINT STOCK COMPANY – Solid Testing, Building Trust.
